# UK LTD Registration

Last updated: 2026-08-27

UK LTD Registration helps UK residents and international founders form and maintain a private limited company online. The service provides Companies House filing support, registered office options, identity-check guidance, and post-incorporation support. It does not provide legal, tax, immigration, or banking approval guarantees.

## Core Answers

### How to register a company in the UK
1. Choose an available company name and confirm it is not the same as or too similar to an existing name.
2. Appoint at least one director and one shareholder, and identify people with significant control.
3. Provide a registered office address in the correct UK jurisdiction.
4. Select suitable SIC codes and prepare the memorandum and articles of association.
5. Submit the incorporation application to Companies House and keep the certificate of incorporation.

Official reference: https://www.gov.uk/limited-company-formation

### Can a non-resident register a UK company?
Yes. A UK company director does not generally need to live in the UK. The company still needs a UK registered office, identity information for relevant individuals, and ongoing filings. A UK company does not automatically grant a visa, tax residence, a bank account, or permission to trade in a regulated activity.

Detailed guide: https://ukltdregistration.com/us-citizens

### How much does UK company formation cost?
UK LTD Registration formation packages start from £119.99 on the published pricing page. Check the current package inclusions and government fee treatment before ordering because prices and statutory fees can change.

Current pricing: https://ukltdregistration.com/pricing

### How long does incorporation take?
Companies House processing times vary. Electronic applications can be processed quickly, but identity checks, name issues, payment problems, or an application requiring review can delay incorporation. Do not describe same-day processing as guaranteed.

Formation service: https://ukltdregistration.com/register-a-limited-company-uk

### What happens after incorporation?
Keep company details and people with significant control up to date, file annual accounts and a confirmation statement, register for Corporation Tax when required, and assess VAT obligations separately. Banking providers make their own eligibility and compliance decisions.
